text: The City Clerk's Office has received notice that Steve Levitan has resigned from the Board of Directors of TO Live effective February 12, 2021. Staff from the Public Appointments Secretariat in the City Clerk's Office are leading a process to recruit applicants and help bring a nominated candidate to City Council for their consideration. If you have any questions about this update, please contact the Public Appointments Secretariat at appoint@toronto.ca or 416-397-0088.
The Board of Directors of TO Live received the item for information.
